title: Open scalar tensor normalization data
statement: For schemes $T$, commutative coefficient rings $A$ and ring maps $A\to B$, record presentations of the ordinary unbounded pro-etale derived tensors and normalized scalar adjunctions [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data, def-sp-open-scalar-operations]. Define $S_T$, its canonical adjoint-uniqueness identification with the published scalar extension, $\lambda$ by the scalar inverse-image mate, and $\beta$ by the common-right-adjoint comparison. Define the scalar restriction/open mate from the identity-on-actions inverse-image square, the restriction tensorator from the flat-term K-flat representative model, its possible strong monoidal normalization, and the scalar projection as the specified scalar adjunct using the B unit, scalar counit and right unitor. Define the forward open projection by prescribing its inverse open adjunct. Record the unchanged normalized scalar composition and identity comparisons and the structure collecting the open-scalar normalization clauses [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-cbc-extension-zero-projection-formula]. These are the existing definitions relocated from the parent module; no operation or equality is changed.
